business_process: Client orders, assignments, and associate call-outs
description: Take job orders from clients; match and confirm associates for next-day shifts; handle same-day call-outs and replacements
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Clients order by phone and email for the next morning; an unfilled shift loses about $150 to $200 of billings each and clients switch agencies after repeated misses; associates must be told where to report
manual_workaround: Forward the office line to the Account Manager's cell phone; printed weekly assignment roster with associate and client supervisor phone numbers (printed every Friday); confirm shifts by phone
dependent_third_parties: ATS vendor; productivity suite vendor; phone carrier; internet provider

description: Enter and approve weekly payroll; fund direct deposits; tax deposits and filings by the payroll service
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll must be submitted by Wednesday 5 p.m. for Friday direct deposit (about $13,500 a week, up to $24,000 in peak weeks); associates who are paid late quit or file wage complaints; one day of slip is the most the firm can absorb
manual_workaround: Re-run the prior week's register adjusted for client-approved hours received by email; payroll vendor's off-cycle run or printed checks; Owner approves
dependent_third_parties: Payroll service vendor; the firm's bank; internet provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Operations Manager; Onboarding and Payroll Coordinator; Owner (backup approver)

business_process: Onboarding: Form I-9, E-Verify, and background checks
description: Collect onboarding packets; complete paper Form I-9 Section 2; create E-Verify cases; order background checks and send FCRA notices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Light Industrial associates often start the next day; Form I-9 Section 2 is due within 3 business days of hire (8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(ii)) and E-Verify cases within 3 employer business days (MOU Art. II.A.9), so a one-day outage is tolerable but not two
manual_workaround: Paper Form I-9 continues as usual; if E-Verify is down, document the outage with a daily screenshot (Fla. Stat. 448.095(2)(c)) and create cases when it returns; order checks in the screening provider's own portal; start only associates already cleared
dependent_third_parties: ATS vendor; background screening provider; DHS E-Verify
dependent_people_or_facilities: Onboarding and Payroll Coordinator; Operations Manager (backup); records room

description: Associates clock in on the payroll app; client supervisors approve hours in the approver portal; the Coordinator resolves exceptions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Approved hours drive both payroll and invoices; Monday to Tuesday approvals feed Wednesday payroll
manual_workaround: Paper timesheets signed by client supervisors and sent by photo or email; Coordinator keys hours by hand
dependent_people_or_facilities: Onboarding and Payroll Coordinator; client supervisors

description: Post jobs; receive applications on the career site, job boards, and the lobby tablet; screen with the AI match feature and by phone; schedule interviews
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The firm keeps a bench of about 40 ready associates, so recruiting can pause for 2 to 3 days without missing orders
manual_workaround: Job boards' own applicant inboxes; paper applications in the lobby; call the bench list
dependent_third_parties: ATS vendor (and its AI subprocessor); job boards

description: Weekly invoices from approved hours; receivables and bank deposits
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $19,400 billed a week; clients pay on 15 to 30 day terms, and the line of credit covers about 3 weeks of payroll
manual_workaround: Invoice from the payroll service's billing report in a spreadsheet; delay invoices by up to a week
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS vendor; payroll service vendor; the firm's bank
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner; Operations Manager; outside CPA firm

description: Shared-drive records: Form I-9 scans, consumer report PDFs, client contracts, policies, questionnaires; paper Form I-9 files
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Forms I-9 must be produced on 3 business days' notice for an inspection (8 CFR 274a.2(b)(2)(ii)); the paper originals are the record of retention
manual_workaround: Paper Forms I-9 in the records room; re-download consumer reports from the screening provider portal; request contract copies from clients
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; backup service; MSP

description: Search, submit, and place candidates in permanent client jobs; invoice the placement fee
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 10 placements a year; searches run for weeks
manual_workaround: Phone and email from any clean device
